Deluxe Award for Joint Battle with Aide
Superior Award for Joint Battle with Aide


How to obtain:

1. Enter Naples and use Chariot to visit Rome
2. Enter the Coliseum and speak to Wallenstein
3. Access 'Mission of Joint Battle with Aide' -- you cannot be in a fleet with other players, and must have an Aide serving as Aide Captain.
4. Complete a land battle with your Aide.

This item (or one of the other Joint Battle chests) may be received at random; you must have inventory space to receive items!

Randomly obtain the following:

Aide Land Battle Record x1
Aide Land Battle Logbook x1
Aide Voyage Record Collection x1
Stone Holy Grail x1
Patriot Award x2
Request Investment Book x2
Relief Ship Boarding Ticket x2
Naumachia Battle Tunic x1
Naumachia Battle Pilum x1
Seal of Sorcery x4
Afternoon Tea Set x4
